messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Getting unformatted \Sexpr output
parts:
The result from \Sexpr{} is passed to the inline hook, and you can
easily override it with

knit_hooks$set(inline = identity)

identity() is a function in base R; identity(x) returns x, so nothing
is changed.

> Hi,

> I find myself in a similar predicament to this user. The output of \Sexpr
> appears as formatted LaTeX rather than the raw figure. For my document I
> perform a lot of calculations and output some of the results inline into the
> text using \Sexpr. The results are usually quantities, I've been using the
> siunitx package to keep the amount and units together. Siunitx requires the
> number to be a raw figure (rather than containing LaTeX markup). Is there a
> way I can convince \Sexpr to just output my data without formatting it.
>
> I've amended the previous guy's example to show what I'm trying to do.
>
> \documentclass{article}
> \usepackage{siunitx}
> \begin{document}
> <<>>=
> x <- 2.2467e6
> @
> $x = \Sexpr{I(x)}$
> $x$ is \SI{\Sexpr{I(x)}}{\ms}.
> \end{document}
>
> The strange thing is that this embedding of \Sexpr within \SI works in the
> majority of cases; there's just certain numbers that \Sexpr decides it wants
> to format (thus breaking \SI).
>
> Cheers,
> Alastair
